name: QuickQuote
tagline: Price a driveway job on your phone, in the driveway.
audience: Sealing, line painting and pressure-washing contractors
before: The estimate gets worked out on paper or in your head, then typed up again at night. Prices drift from job to job and the customer waits a day for a number.
after: Pick the service, enter the measurements, and get a clean quote with your own prices while you are still standing in the driveway. Sealing and repair, line painting and pressure washing.
privacy_note: Prices, business details, and quote history are stored in this browser's local storage. This page does not upload them to us. A supplier link opens a Google Maps search when you tap it. Text / Share passes the quote text to the phone's share sheet, or copies it if sharing is unavailable.
origin: Built first for Seals Go Pro, a driveway sealing business. Type your own business name in Settings.
built_with: One web page, built with AI. Works on a phone.
